title: PBA Player of the Week Gomez de Liaño stands out in Converge’s big wins vs Macau, TNT
summary: Converge super rookie Juan Gomez de Liaño stood out in the FiberXers' big wins over Macau and TNT to grab No. 3 seeding of Group A in the coming PBA Governors’ Cup playoffs.
